data.one_liner: A strict and satisfying lint package for Flame, Flutter, or Dart projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of strict lint rules used across Flame Engine and Blue Fire projects. It can be included in a project's analysis_options.yaml file to enforce coding standards.
use_when: You want to apply Flame Engine coding standards and lint rules to your project
You are looking for a strict set of lints for a Dart, Flutter, or Flame project
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter lint rules without strict additions
strengths: Maintained by the Flame Engine team
weaknesses: Strict lint rules may require significant refactoring in existing codebases
data.setup_notes: Add flame_lint as a dependency and include package:flame_lint/analysis_options.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.
